draft.title: Personal reflection in the PIP
card: A PIP is more than a report of findings. It also shows the student's own thinking: why they chose the topic, what they noticed, and how their views changed.
the student's own account of what they learned from the research, including about themselves and about the process.
the findings and conclusions rest on the evidence collected, not on what the student already believed or hoped to find.
A student can do both. They can say how the research changed their view, while showing that the evidence, not their opinion, led to the conclusion.
draft.remember: Reflection shows what the student learned. Objectivity keeps the findings tied to evidence.

a.q: Which sentence in a PIP best combines reflection with objectivity?
opts: My view shifted after interviews showed many disagreed
I always believed I was right, and the research proved it
Everyone I spoke to agreed with me, so my view is correct
I left out my own views because they do not matter here
a.why: The first sentence names a change in the student's thinking and links it to evidence from the research. The second lets prior belief decide the result. The third treats agreement as proof, and the fourth removes the reflection the PIP needs.
a.clue: Look for a personal change that is tied to evidence.

b.q: Jas is writing a PIP on teenage gaming habits. Which approach best keeps her research objective while including reflection?
opts: Report all survey results, then reflect on what surprised her
Report only the results that match what she expected to find
Replace the survey results with her own gaming experience
Skip reflection and give only the survey results as numbers
b.why: Jas reports all of the evidence and then reflects on what she learned, so her thinking is shown without bending the findings. Choosing only expected results harms objectivity. Using her own experience in place of data weakens the research, and skipping reflection leaves out her thinking.
b.clue: Reflection comes after the evidence, and it does not replace or filter it.
